free_tier.stated: Upload, send and share large files for free, without registration, until 25Go by file.
free_tier.notes: The page is a short landing page in English and French; Go is gigabyte. A direct read is answered by a bot-protection block page, so the text was read through a pinned provider.

per_object_cap.notes: bytes = 25 x 1024^3, reading Go as gigabyte.

retention.stated: unverified: no retention period is printed on the landing page

egress.terms: unverified: no download allowance is printed on the landing page.

interface_detail: Web upload; no API page was read.
chaining: 25 GB per file with no registration; the retention and any download cap are unpublished.

limits.value: a bot-protection service blocks some client addresses with a ban page

binding_note: 25 GB per file is the only published number.
reliability_note: A direct read answered 'Sorry, you are banned' from a bot-protection service on 2026-11-03; a pinned provider read the landing page.
confidence_note: Landing page read on 2026-11-03 through a pinned provider after a direct read was blocked. Retention, egress and any paid tier are unverified.
